assets.name: Beelzebub — salon du bar
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one landscape background for a 2D fighting game, 16:9 composition. Repaint the supplied official Helluva Boss background layout as the side bar lounge at Beelzebub's reception, preserving the room's characteristic geometry and color relationships: warm peach-orange walls and floor, broad cream ceiling covered in a delicate honeycomb pattern, curved orange honeycomb-faced bar entering from the left, cyan honeycomb wallpaper behind the bar, two pale yellow columns with coral capitals, central rectangular archway into a rounded teal booth with hexagon upholstery and a long golden pedestal table, pale cyan rectangular aquarium-like window above the booth, turquoise geometric rug beginning at lower right. Keep the left teal honeycomb room-divider screen in place. Remove the RIGHT honeycomb divider screen completely, leaving only its peach wall behind it, because it will be a separate layer. Remove ALL bar stools entirely because they will be separate props. Preserve the clean confident hand-drawn 2D animation linework and flat shaded materials of the reference, with no photoreal textures. Adjust ONLY the foreground floor perspective enough to provide a continuous unobstructed horizontal playable strip across the bottom 25 percent. Keep room corners, doorway connections and column feet plausible. No people, no characters, no words, no signs, no HUD, no watermark, no object pasted across the combat strip. Entire scene opaque. Single background image.

references.title: Greg Bartlett — Helluva Boss layout and paint portfolio

fidelityNotes: Cadrage et sol avant adaptés au combat 2D, avec la banquette et le bar conservés.
Les tabourets et la cloison droite ont été retirés du fond pour leur placement en couches distinctes.
Les motifs fins, reflets et proportions sont redessinés ; fidélité artistique 1:1 non certifiée.

assets.name: Beelzebub — tabouret cyan du salon
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Derive exactly ONE isolated game prop from the supplied Helluva Boss production background: the nearest bar stool visible at the far lower-left of the reference. Only reproduce that stool, as a hand-painted 2D animation-cel object. Its silhouette is a wide low rounded rectangular/oval deep teal seat with lighter cyan honeycomb hexagon upholstery, supported by one very slender pale cyan silver stem that flares smoothly into a broad curved trumpet foot. Preserve the seat-to-stem proportions and the cyan/teal/gold-edge colors in the reference. View from the same slightly elevated three-quarter front angle so the padded top and front edge of the seat are visible. Do not add a backrest, armrests, wheels, legs, footrest rings, buttons or an invented ornamental pedestal. Entire single stool in frame, centered with at least 10 percent transparent margin around all edges. Clean tapered outlines, restrained cel shadows, no photographic texture. Fully transparent background and real alpha, no checkerboard, no floor, no cast shadow, no other furniture or objects, no text or labels. A production sprite ready for a separate background layer.

references.title: Greg Bartlett — Helluva Boss layout and paint portfolio

fidelityNotes: Le pied cyan évasé et la sellerie à alvéoles suivent le tabouret visible dans la référence.
L’épaisseur des liserés et le dessin des reflets sont adaptés à la taille de jeu.
Un seul tabouret indépendant ; les positions sont un choix de composition de la simulation.

assets.name: Beelzebub — cloison à alvéoles du salon
assets.prompt:
Make a FRAMING-ONLY correction to this one isolated turquoise honeycomb divider. Preserve EXACTLY its existing geometry: three aligned vertical columns of EIGHT complete hexagonal holes each, with two intermediate offset columns of SEVEN holes each, THIRTY-EIGHT holes total. Preserve every row, bar, flat cel color, fine dark teal outer outline, and narrow peach highlight. Do not redesign, add, remove or rearrange any hexagon.
Zoom out: uniformly reduce the entire existing object to about 80 percent of its present scale and center it on a portrait canvas. Finish the tiny dark outline clipped at the bottom edge so the entire bottom contour is visibly complete. There must be a generous EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN BELOW THE LOWEST DARK OUTLINE, at least 120 pixels on a 1536-pixel-tall canvas. Also leave transparent margins above and at both sides. The single complete lattice should fit safely INSIDE the canvas, occupying roughly80 percent of the canvas height.
This is a single static 2D game prop. True transparent RGBA background outside AND inside all38 openings. No green background, no glow, no shadow, no floor, no base or feet, no additional frames, no objects, no lettering, no display board, no checkerboard. Preserve the correct eight-row structure while fixing only the cut-off framing.

The current divider is too tall: it has nine large hexagonal holes down each of its three main columns. Rebuild the complete panel so each of the three main columns has EXACTLY SIX large hexagonal holes from top to bottom, and each of the two interstitial columns has EXACTLY FIVE smaller offset hexagonal holes. Thus exactly 28 open holes total, no extra row. It must be a shorter, wider-looking panel matching the original room screen: its metal silhouette's width should be approximately 60 percent of its height. Preserve the same teal metal, peach-gold rims, ring thickness, line style and front-facing perspective. Do not crop the existing nine-row screen; produce the corrected complete six-row silhouette, all bottom and top rings complete, with real transparent holes and transparent background, clean alpha, centered with comfortable margins. No feet, no floor, no shadows, no text, no labels. One panel only.
